Mark: Quick plan: 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. 6m watch between steps. If p95 increases > 200ms or 5xx uptick > 0.8% immediate rollback.

Theo: Commands I'll run with lbctl. Example: `lbctl set-split --route /v1/chat --split A=98,A-v2=2 --note "micro-step"` to move 2%. Rollback: `lbctl set-split --route /v1/chat --split A=100 --force --note "rollback"`.

deploy-bot: job/quiet-swap-1749801111 queued. Link: https://deploy.internal/jobs/quiet-swap-1749801111

Mark: Monitoring queries: p95: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le))`, 5xx rate: `increase(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[6m]) / increase(http_requests_total[6m])`. I'll post OK/WARN/FAIL after each step.

Lina: QA: run golden prompts after 8% and 60%. If semantic deltas > 2 flagged examples -> pause.

Nora: If cookie affinity skews results, we can switch to header-split `X-Canary` briefly. I'll prep header cohort.
